verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a developer API product, so least-privilege credentials are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that plain API keys are free to create, that no OAuth flow is needed, and that agents can pay via MPP without any key. Nothing documents scopes, permission restrictions, or per-agent limited keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
